notes.title: Update Note
notes.content:
According to the feedback of some players and the data of the market, it shows that our game is too difficult, which causes many players to doubt the game experience of life. I'm very sorry.

We took the time to make some adjustments to the difficulty of the game

Fixed some small bugs (we did it for four people in spare time, some of the bugs we received could not be reproduced, I'm very sorry)

As a zero publicity independent game, we are grateful to have a group of players to play. Hope to play the players who think it's good, don't grudge to give us a favorable comment, which is also equivalent to publicity.
